title: Koneko no Haitatsuin Uunyan (2026)

alternative_titles.ja: 子猫の配達員うーにゃん

synopsis: Uunyan is a tiny kitten who just started working as a delivery courier. He is easily distracted by donuts, tends to drop pizzas, and generally struggles to make his hard work pay off. Despite this, every day Uunyan earnestly sets out on his delivery route. The townspeople quietly watch over Uunyan, occasionally lending a helping hand, and they continually cheer him on—celebrating his growth as if it were their own.
